philippines.title: Four fishermen arrested for illegal use of air compressor in Romblon
philippines.description:
CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Four fishermen were arrested Wednesday, Aug. 12, after they were caught using an air compressor as a breathing apparatus while allegedly engaged in illegal fishing activities in the waters off Sitio Maglihi, Barangay Marigondon, Cajidiocan, Romblon. The arrest was made at 11:30 a.m. during a seaborne law enforcement operation conducted by the Cajidiocan Municipal Police Station (MPS) in coordination with the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG)-Cajidiocan. Police said compression diving violates Municipal Ordinance No. 03-11, Section 67, which prohibits the use of air compressors for fishing and other underwater activities within the municipal waters of Cajidiocan. philippines.title: Shinee members under probe in unlicensed medical practice scandal
philippines.description:
Police investigating allegations of illegal, unlicensed medical practices targeting celebrities have questioned several major entertainers, including K-pop group Shinee members Onew and Key. The Gangnam Police Station in Seoul questioned TV personality Jun Hyun-moo, Shinee members Key and Onew, and popular YouTuber Lickerish Hatnim (Kim Mi-kyung) through July. The questioning was part of a widening investigation into allegations that the entertainers received medical treatments from an unlicensed practitioner. At the center of the probe is a suspect identified only by the surname Lee. The authorities suspect Lee administered IV infusions to celebrity clients in vehicles and at residential officetels. philippines.title: Tacloban declares school shooting victim Chris Fabian as ‘Young Hero’
philippines.description:
TACLOBAN CITY — The city government here has officially declared on Thursday slain student and scout Chris Lorenz Fabian as the city’s “Young Hero.” It honored his courage and selfless sacrifice during the tragic shooting at San Jose National High School (SJNHS) on June 22. The recognition was conferred through City Ordinance No. 2026-16-15, which recognizes Fabian’s “extraordinary selfless courage and supreme sacrifice” in the face of danger. Fabian’s mother, Erbea Fabian, accepted the recognition on behalf of her late son and expressed gratitude to the city government and everyone who continues to honor the memory and bravery of the 15-year-old scout. usStocks.title: AI Weekly: Nvidia does deal with Wall Street, China's AI weather forecasts
usStocks.description: STORY: From Nvidia's deal with Wall Street giants... to China's AI weather forecasting This is AI Weekly. :: AI Weekly Nvidia has partnered with six major financial institutions to launch compute financing platforms. They are aimed at raising over $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said on X the company has the option to backstop up to $125 billion, or 25% of the potential deals. The move highlights how surging demand for AI computing capacity is drawing institutional investors. South Korea will launch a $3.5 billion semiconductor fund targeting promising chip materials, parts, equipment and fabless companies. Seoul says it seeks to accelerate plans for new chip manufacturing hubs across the country. Under the plan, Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, suppliers and local governments are expected to invest more than $576 billion in new chip manufacturing projects. A French press association has asked the country's competition watchdog to take action against Google's AI-generated article summaries. The trade group says they deprive newspapers and magazines of readers. The group has called on the regulator to make a decision similar to one ordered against Meta. To put forward a payment plan and resume talks with traditional media seeking fees for the use of their content by AI tools. China is emerging as a leading player in the race to improve weather prediction through AI. Meteorologists used a new generation of AI weather models alongside traditional forecasting systems as they tracked Typhoon Dolphin's path. Researchers say they can generate forecasts much faster than conventional systems while matching or surpassing them on some measures of accuracy.
usStocks.source: Yahoo! Finance: AAPL MSFT GOOGL AMZA NVDA News
